changes.summary: FERC must report annually on specified pending hydropower licensing applications, beginning within 180 days; the law creates reporting duties, not project approvals or shorter licensing times.
The law replaces 2026 with 2028 in two authorization provisions; it does not itself state a funding amount, obligate money or establish completed construction.
The Court of Federal Claims may hear one Treaty of Grouseland claim without limitations defenses if filed within a year; other Illinois land claims are extinguished.
Commerce must standardize and publish geospatial information on fishing and recreational restrictions within multi-year deadlines while protecting Tribal waters and sensitive information.
